dogecoin.text:
Happy Monday! Let’s make $DOGE the fun uncle of crypto.

Bitcoin is for the suits in skyscrapers, the ones who call a 0.1% dip ‘a market correction.’ $DOGE is for the rest of us. 

It’s the fun uncle who shows up to the family BBQ on a jet ski, ready to tip a great meme!

🚀 Jordan Jefferson, CEO of MyDoge & DogeOS, breaks down how #Dogecoin evolved from meme to movement — community-powered and ready to shake up traditional finance.

Could Doge really become the people’s currency? 🐶💸
